steps.title: Visit the AIW3 airdrop page
steps.body: Go to the AIW3 airdrop page and open the Airdrop tab. This is where your points, tasks, and ranking live.

steps.title: Connect your wallet and complete the tutorial
steps.body: Connect your wallet and then finish the onboarding tutorial on the Airdrop tab. Wallet binding is required for the snapshot, so do this before July 28.

steps.body: Hit the check-in button every day. Rewards follow a 7-day cycle that climbs from 3 points on day 1 to 10 points on day 7, and missing a day does not reset your progress.

steps.body: Follow AIW3 on X, repost the featured campaign post, and join the AIW3 Telegram from the airdrop page. These one-time tasks pay 10 to 20 points each and take about two minutes.

steps.title: Make daily predictions
steps.body: Complete at least one prediction market entry per day for 20 points. Three predictions in a day pays 50 points, and inviting a friend who completes a prediction adds another 30. The prediction tasks reset daily, so they compound fast for consistent users.

steps.title: Trade on the platform
steps.body: You earn points for every 1,000 USDT in trading volume, plus milestone bonuses for consistent activity. You can grab USDT or SOL on Bybit , and if your funds sit on another chain, the widget below moves them over to Solana or BNB Chain in one transaction. steps.body: Check the eligibility page from July 29, then claim your tokens when TGE goes live on August 3.

steps.title: Visit Onchain.cc
steps.body: Head to the Onchain.cc terminal and click “Start trading” on the landing page.

steps.title: Authenticate with Privy
steps.body: Sign in using one of the supported methods: Email — Privy creates an embedded non-custodial wallet for you. Google account — same flow as email, signed in with Gmail. External EVM wallet — connect MetaMask, Rabby, or another EVM wallet. Privy handles key management without holding your funds, so you keep custody throughout.

steps.title: Fund Your Wallets
steps.body: Open the wallet menu in the top right to see your Solana and EVM addresses. Ensure you have USDC, SOL, or ETH in your wallet. If you don’t have any, you can get them from Binance or swap and bridge funds directly using the widget below.

steps.title: Place Your First Trade
steps.body: Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab Three discovery paths feed into the same trading panel: Degen Feed (Trenches): Solana-only memecoin discovery with trending tokens and new launches. Contract address search: paste any token’s CA into the search bar to load its chart directly. Discover tab: filter by volume, market cap, or other criteria to find trending markets. Set your size, check the slippage estimate, and submit. Points accrue automatically based on your volume and any session multipliers active at the time.

steps.title: Climb the Colosseum Leaderboard
steps.body: Open the Colosseum tab to see the active season, current session timer, and any live Bonus Windows. Trading during a Bonus Window (typically 2x or 3x points for a few hours) is the fastest way to push your session rank.

steps.title: Earn Points from X Posts
steps.body: Onchain.cc runs a social scoring system that pays Colosseum points for posting about the platform on X. Tag the official @Onchaincc account so the AI scorer picks up your post. Quality, reach, and engagement determine the score on a 0–100 scale. Posts that share a real trade, include a screenshot of the terminal, or generate organic engagement score well. Spam and copy-paste content score near zero.

steps.title: Trade Perps on Hyperliquid Markets
steps.body: Switch to the perps tab to trade Hyperliquid’s 300+ markets from the same interface. Perp volume feeds into your Colosseum points the same way spot volume does, often with higher leverage and tighter spreads. Check funding rates before opening leveraged positions.

steps.title: Stack Sessions and Refer Friends
steps.body: Sessions reset weekly, each with its own leaderboard and USDC prize pool. Daily and weekly quests sit alongside the leaderboard, adding points and prize pool entries on top of your trading activity. You can also refer your friends to earn more points.

items.description: The Onchain.cc team has not confirmed a native token or token airdrop. The platform’s Colosseum points system, sessions, and seasonal leaderboards point toward a possible retroactive reward for early traders, similar to how other trading terminals have rewarded volume contributors before launching a token.

items.name: Flop Labs
items.tagline: The airdrop is confirmed. Hayes has stated a large $FLOP distribution is planned for Q4 2026, ahead of the genesis block

steps.title: Follow Flop Labs on X
steps.body: Follow the official Flop Labs X account and turn on notifications. This is the only requirement the project has published for eligibility, and it is where testnet dates will land first.

steps.title: Follow Arthur Hayes for early terms
steps.body: Follow CryptoHayes and subscribe to his Substack. His essays have carried more detail than the project account, including the 20% testnet figure, and more are coming. Terms tend to surface there first.

steps.title: Apply for a network role
steps.body: Open the Flop website and submit the form matching what you can deliver. Three of the four roles are open: GPU provider or miner: for anyone with hardware that can run inference. Miners earn block rewards plus payment per job. No minimum specifications have been published, so treat any circulating hardware requirement as unverified. Validator: confirms miners completed their assigned work and stores agent memory. Suited to people comfortable running nodes. KOL or creator: the lowest barrier of the three. A few solid posts plus the form is the entry price, and Substack counts, which helps if your X account is weak. The fourth role, Agents, is the demand side: they spend $FLOP rather than earn it, so there is nothing to apply for.

steps.title: Start publishing $FLOP content now
steps.body: If you took the creator route, post before the program formally opens. There is no leaderboard yet, and if scoring ends up mindshare-based it will likely be applied retroactively. Stay on theme: decentralized inference, GPU economics, Hayes’ argument that the AI buildout is a debt problem rather than a technology one.

steps.title: Get ready for the Q4 testnet
steps.body: The 20% allocation is earned on the testnet, which has not opened. Hold off on configuring a wallet for a specific network, because Flop Labs has not named the chain. Watch the official account and be ready to onboard when it goes live.

items.description: The airdrop is confirmed. Hayes has stated a large $FLOP distribution is planned for Q4 2026, ahead of the genesis block in Q1 2027, though eligibility rules and snapshot dates are unpublished. His 19 August essay put roughly 20% of supply with testnet participants, released across ten years.

steps.body: The weekly check-in pays 20 points and resets every seven days. One click, and skipping it is the easiest way to leak points over a long campaign.

steps.body: Use the Get My Referral Link button. You earn 20% of your direct referrals’ earnings plus 5% from anyone they refer, and each friend gets 100 XP for signing up through you. Credit takes 24 to 48 hours, and referred accounts must connect X first.

items.description: Beldex runs a Loyalty Program that awards Beldex Points for social and community tasks and ranks participants on a public leaderboard. steps.body: At TGE, claim your allocation through the rewards section on mint.io. You can then stake your $MNTD to activate MINT Status, earn compounded staking rewards and start moving up the levels.

steps.title: Open the Genesis Vault and Connect Your Wallet
steps.body: Go to the HertzFlow Genesis Vault page and connect an EVM wallet. Anything supported by Privy works, including OKX Wallet, MetaMask, and Rabby. No invite code, no whitelist.

steps.title: Fund Your Wallet
steps.body: You need USD1 or U plus a little BNB for gas. Stablecoins can be bought on Bybit and withdrawn straight to BNB Chain. If your funds sit elsewhere, the widget below will bridge or swap them across. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. steps.title: Review and Accept the User Agreement
steps.body: Three disclosures gate the deposit form: smart contract risk, PnL exposure after mainnet, and the custody path. Deposits are wrapped into the underlying USD1 or U and held in Ceffu custody, so read it rather than clicking past.

steps.title: Deposit USD1 or U Into the Genesis Vault
steps.body: Enter at least $10 after fees, then approve and confirm. Holding a different token is fine, since the deposit flow swaps into USD1 or U first. Once the phase cap fills, the vault stops taking new money while existing deposits keep running.

steps.body: Optional, and it changes nothing about deposits or Merits. It does register you for future campaign eligibility, so there is little reason to skip.

steps.title: Hold the Deposit for 90 Continuous Days
steps.body: The boost is all or nothing. A deposit held 89 days earns the base rate; at 90 days it earns 10x on everything accrued over that window. After day 90 the boost stops growing, but base Merits keep accruing.

steps.title: Trade Once Season 2 Opens
steps.body: Perpetual trading opens in Season 2 once the Season 1 window closes, and depositors are already on the early access list. Trading uses a separate on-chain referral system that has not launched yet.

items.description: HertzFlow has confirmed both a token generation event and an airdrop. Official documentation describes Merits, the protocol’s reward points, as your weight in that airdrop: at TGE they convert into an allocation and reset to zero. Season 1 runs entirely through the Genesis Vault, a capped pre-deposit event where every Merit comes from supplying liquidity. Neither the allocation size nor a TGE date has been published.

steps.body: Open the in-app faucet and claim. The claim sends 10,000 test USDC straight to your wallet.

steps.title: Approve USDC and Place Your First Trade
steps.body: Pick a live market, choose YES or NO, and enter an amount. Your first trade needs a one-time approval transaction before the buy confirms. Fees are 2% per trade, and selling works like buying, so you can exit any position up to one hour before expiry.

steps.title: Trade Across Markets and Test Leverage
steps.body: Spread bets across categories rather than parking everything in one market. Then try a leveraged position; 5x and 10x tiers unlock on higher-volume markets. Liquidations use a 30-minute average of the odds rather than spot, so one erratic trade will not instantly close you out.

steps.title: Create Your Own Markets
steps.body: Head to the market creation page and write a clearly worded question with an unambiguous resolution source. The protocol seeds the liquidity, so you take no market-making risk, and you collect 0.5% of every trade on your market for life.

steps.title: Stake in the LP Vault
steps.body: Deposit test USDC into the LP vault, which lends to leveraged traders and pays depositors a cut of their fees. Lock tiers of Flex, 90, 180, and 365 days carry point multipliers of 1x, 2x, 4x, and 8x, and the multiplier only applies while the lock is active. Withdrawals sit through a 7-day cooldown, even on Flex.

steps.body: Track your P&L on the leaderboard, work through the onboarding achievements, and collect badges as you trade. Share your referral link from the dashboard to bring in other traders.

steps.body: Pick a narrative, choose a risk tier, and set your investment amount. The AI generates the basket, you review it, and you execute it on-chain. Each portfolio you create earns 250 points, and you can edit the basket through the chat before executing.

steps.title: Claim the Daily Bonus
steps.body: Log in every day and claim the 500 point daily bonus from the Earning Opportunities dashboard. Streaks are the cheapest points on the platform, so set a reminder.

steps.title: Complete the Social Tasks
steps.body: Finish the X based social tasks in your dashboard for another 500 points. These are one time tasks and take a few minutes.

steps.title: Join the Prove Your Portfolio Campaign
steps.body: Build one on-chain portfolio per day and share your portfolio card on X. This earns guaranteed Gem rewards from the $100,000 pool and stacks with the points you already earn per portfolio.

steps.title: Activate Your Referral Link
steps.body: Open the Referrals tab and click “Activate”. Referrals pay dollar rewards on top of points, and your network’s trading counts toward your Gems.

items.description: AlloX has not confirmed an airdrop, but its reward system points clearly at one. The $ALLOX token is unlaunched, with a token generation event planned for Q3 2026, and the platform runs two parallel reward currencies: points for everyday activity and Gems for volume based campaigns. AlloX has stated that 1 Gem will equal $5 in $ALLOX at launch, and over $1 million in rewards is spread across ongoing campaigns.

items.name: Push Chain
items.tagline: The $PC airdrop is confirmed. The official tokenomics proposal reserves 10% of the 10 billion total supply for airdrops.

steps.title: Visit the Push Portal
steps.body: Go to the Push Portal rewards page and log in with a wallet or a social account. If you farmed Season 1 or 2, use the same wallet so your earlier points carry over.

steps.title: Verify your social accounts
steps.body: Follow PushChain on X and join the Push Chain Discord , then complete verification inside the portal. This unlocks the quest board and referral link.

steps.title: Claim testnet PC from the faucet
steps.body: Click the wallet icon inside the portal to open the faucet and claim 1 free PC token. The faucet resets every 6 hours, so grab it a few times a day to keep enough gas for the onchain quests.

steps.title: Complete the universal app challenges
steps.body: Work through the quests attached to each app in the weekly rotation: play, or predict, depending on the app. These challenges are the main XP source in Season 3.

steps.title: Check in daily
steps.body: Hit the daily check-in whenever you open the portal. Streaks stack a bonus on top of the base reward, and a missed day resets it.

steps.title: Use the daily spin
steps.body: The Spin 2 Win wheel pays out Rare Passes, testnet $PC, and other rewards once per day. It takes a few seconds and is one of the few pass sources outside of leveling.

steps.title: Collect Rare Passes
steps.body: Stack as many Rare Passes as you can through level ups and spins. All passes get burned at TGE for a shot at a Shiny Pass, and the bigger your stash, the better your odds.

steps.title: Invite friends
steps.body: Share your referral link from the portal. You earn 16% of the points your invites generate and another 8% from the people they invite. Extra invite slots unlock as your referrals reach level 7, so help your invites stay active.

steps.title: Climb the leaderboard
steps.body: Leaderboards are live and track actual network usage. A higher rank heading into TGE positions you for a larger share of the season allocation.

items.description: The $PC airdrop is confirmed. The official tokenomics proposal reserves 10% of the 10 billion total supply for airdrops. It covers past and present Push Protocol users along with new Push Chain participants, creators, and developers. Distributions begin at TGE and roll out across multiple seasons rather than in a single drop.

steps.title: Visit the Worldie Early Access Page
steps.body: Go to the Worldie early access page and click “Join early.” Sign in with your X account or Google.

steps.title: Join the Worldie Discord
steps.body: Use the Discord icon on the early access page to join the official Worldie Discord. The +400 World Points bonus is added once you’re in the server.

steps.title: Connect Your X Account and Wallet
steps.body: Open the “Get your invite” panel and connect X (if you signed in with Google) along with a wallet. Connecting both locks your referral link. There is no deposit step.

steps.title: Claim Your Invite Link
steps.body: Claim your personal invite link from the same panel. Worldie ties the link to your name.

steps.title: Share Your Link
steps.body: Send the link to friends and communities that would use a social trading app. A referral only counts after the invited user signs up and connects both X and a wallet, so mention both requirements when you share it.

steps.title: Track Your Rank on the Leaderboard
steps.body: Click “See the board” to check your World Points and position. Global, Friends, This Week, and All Time tabs let you compare yourself against everyone or just your own network.

items.description: Worldie has not confirmed an airdrop, and the $WORLDIE token has not launched. The early access page invites users to “be early for $WORLDIE,” and the team says the token will launch on Worldie through Pons, with the announcement coming first on its official channels.

steps.title: Add GIWA Sepolia to your wallet
steps.body: Open MetaMask or another EVM wallet and add GIWA Sepolia, chain ID 91342.

steps.title: Claim GIWA Sepolia test ETH
steps.body: Request test ETH from the Lambda256 faucet linked on Ammora’s mission page. The liquidity mission has a 0.001 ETH minimum and gas on GIWA is negligible, so you need very little.

steps.title: Join the Ammora waitlist
steps.body: Go to the Ammora waitlist , connect your wallet, sign the message and register an email. Every mission stays locked until this is done, and the wallet you use will be publicly tied to the leaderboard.

steps.title: Follow @AmmoraHQ on X
steps.body: Follow the official Ammora account from the X account you want credited, then return to the dashboard to verify for 100 AP.

steps.title: Retweet the pinned post
steps.body: Repost the pinned campaign post from the same X account for another 100 AP.

steps.title: Publish the daily X post
steps.body: The dashboard fills in the post text for you, so this takes seconds. At 200 AP it is the highest paying repeatable mission.

steps.title: Supply test ETH liquidity
steps.body: Press Supply on the daily liquidity mission and deposit at least 0.001 GIWA Sepolia test ETH into the Ammora vault. Each verified supply pays 50 AP. Repeat it daily.

steps.title: Clear the Launch Week bonus
steps.body: Complete all five missions once during Launch Week, meaning joining, following, retweeting, posting and supplying. It is the largest single chunk of points available and it disappears when the window closes.

steps.title: Share your referral link
steps.body: Open the referral tab on the waitlist page and copy your link. Each signup credits 200 AP up to a cap of five, so 1,000 AP is on the table.

items.description: Ammora has no token and has not announced an airdrop, so this is a speculative play on a points program that may or may not convert into a distribution. What the team has committed to is beta access: the leaderboard guarantees seats to the top 1,000 point holders, plus 100 more drawn at random from everyone else.

steps.title: Create Your Acepyr Account
steps.body: Sign up at Acepyr with an email and password, entering referral code PW34SD3C2J during registration. Codes only count when applied at signup. Verify your email to activate the account.

steps.title: Accept the Legal Documents and Complete Onboarding
steps.body: First login walks you through the Terms of Service, Privacy Policy and Testnet Points Notice, then the onboarding survey. Those steps plus your first sign-in pay 300 testnet $ACEPYR.

steps.title: Link a Wallet You Control
steps.body: In Settings, link a wallet by signing a message; a pasted address does not qualify. One address links to one account permanently, and linking pays 500 testnet $ACEPYR.

steps.title: Join the Mainnet Waitlist
steps.body: The most productive click on the platform. Joining needs a proven wallet holding at least the current minimum, now $10, read live across Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon and BSC. Native coins and major stablecoins count, and nothing is sent to Acepyr, so balances you already hold for Base , Arbitrum or Optimism farming clear the check. Joining pays 1,000 testnet $ACEPYR, puts the first 10,000 qualifying accounts in line for $5 at launch, and activates whoever referred you. Short of the minimum? Pick up ETH or USDC on Bybit , then use the widget below to move it onto Base or another supported chain. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab

steps.title: Trade the Live Up or Down Markets
steps.body: Take Up or Down on a five-minute window and let the price feed settle it. Three first-time achievements sit here: Open your first position: 250 testnet $ACEPYR Place your first limit order: 250 testnet $ACEPYR Close your first profitable position: 300 testnet $ACEPYR

steps.title: Enter the Weekly Tournament
steps.body: Entry is free and individual, with no ticket and no minimum balance. One settled trade that week makes you valid and earns a share of the 10,000 testnet $ACEPYR pool.

steps.title: Build a Sign-In Streak
steps.body: The streak pays at five rungs: 50 at two days, 100 at three, 300 at seven, 500 at fourteen and 1,000 at thirty. Each rung banks permanently.

steps.title: Generate Your Referral Code
steps.body: Open Profile, then Referrals. Codes reset every month and points do not carry over.

items.description: No Acepyr airdrop has been announced. The company’s terms are blunt: testnet $ACEPYR is a symbolic point system with no economic value, it cannot be bought, and it may never be worth anything.

steps.title: Log In With Your X Account
steps.body: Go to the REP app and sign in with X. This becomes the anchor identity for your profile, and REP reads public metrics like follower quality to seed your first badges.

steps.title: Connect Your Wallets
steps.body: Open your profile and bind your wallets. REP supports roughly five addresses per account, EVM and others. Use the wallets with the deepest history, since an empty wallet produces no achievements. You only sign a message to prove ownership, with no approvals or transfers.

steps.title: Link Your Other Social Accounts
steps.body: Add Telegram, Farcaster, Discord, and any other supported platform from the profile page. Each one widens the pool of achievements you qualify for.

steps.title: Claim Your Achievements
steps.body: Open the achievements list and claim every badge you qualify for. Values range from a few hundred REP points for social milestones up to 3,000 for top-percentile DeFi activity. Some claims charge a small on-chain fee, so keep a little of the relevant gas token in your connected wallet. You can buy it on Bybit and withdraw it directly, or move assets you already hold with the widget below to bridge or swap onto the chain you need. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab

steps.title: Set Your Remoji Rank
steps.body: Ranks run across seven tiers, from pilgrim at the bottom to the top 0.5% band. Once your badges are claimed, set the rank emoji on your REP profile and on Telegram, where it acts as the signal other users read before connecting with you.

steps.title: Browse Matches and Join Rooms
steps.body: Open the Matches section to see communities your reputation qualifies you for. Some rooms ask for an email address. Join the ones relevant to your activity rather than every room on the list.

steps.title: Share Your Social Graph Invite Link
steps.body: Grab your personal invite link from the Social Graph section and share it. Invites are weighted by who accepts them, so a handful of active wallets beats a long list of empty ones.

items.description: REP has not announced a token or an airdrop. What exists is a live points system where achievements and connections award REP points that feed a public ranking.

steps.title: Connect your wallet to Entropy
steps.body: Go to the Entropy trading app and connect Rabby, MetaMask, or another supported wallet.

steps.title: Set your username
steps.body: Finish account setup and pick a username.

steps.title: Deposit USDC to your Hyperliquid account
steps.body: Entropy markets settle in USDC held in your Hyperliquid perps balance, funded via Arbitrum. steps.title: Trade the live Entropy markets
steps.body: Open positions on io:ANTH, io:SNDK, io:NBIS, or io:GPRO. Leverage caps run from 5x to 10x by market, and isolated margin keeps any liquidation contained to that position.

steps.title: Create or apply a referral code
steps.body: Generate a code on the referrals page to earn a share of fees from signups. Applying someone else’s code gives you a fee benefit matching their tier.

steps.title: Build volume on Entropy markets
steps.body: Rebate tiers track rolling 30-day volume on Entropy markets. Volume on native Hyperliquid perps like BTC or ETH counts for Hyperliquid but not toward Entropy tiers.

items.description: Entropy has no token and no announced airdrop. Its site, docs, and X account make no mention of a token, points program, season, or quest system. items.name: C8ntinuum
items.tagline: C8ntinuum has announced a live contribution program: p8ints accrue from past and ongoing activity, then become spendable

steps.title: Create Your C8ntinuum Account
steps.body: Open the C8ntinuum dashboard and sign in with email, a wallet or a social account. p8ints accrue to the account itself, not to any single wallet.

steps.title: Claim Your Legacy p8ints
steps.body: Waitlist entries, and OG status campaign entries are credited in the dashboard.

steps.title: Complete the Social Tasks
steps.body: Connect and verify your X, Discord and Telegram accounts, then follow and join the official channels. Each task pays once at a fixed rate, and the verified X follow counts toward qualification.

steps.title: Check In Daily and Spin the Wheel
steps.body: The check-in runs through days 1 to 7 of Season 0 and stands in for a qualifying day if you have not bought $CTM yet. The wheel gives one spin per UTC day and never subtracts.

steps.title: Buy and Hold $CTM Across Chains
steps.body: Holding is scored per chain, not on a combined balance, so positions on Ethereum, BNB Chain and Solana each earn separately and stack. A chain needs at least 5 CTM before it scores. Buy ETH, BNB or SOL on Bybit , withdraw to your own wallet, then use the widget below to move funds onto the chain you plan to hold on. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab

steps.title: Supply $CTM Liquidity
steps.body: Pooled positions are scored daily on their $CTM side and outweigh passive holding. Each token counts in one category only, so $CTM in a pool stops scoring as holding.

steps.title: Verify NFT Ownership for Partner Drops
steps.body: Selected partner collections pay a one-time credit across three tiers, once per collection. Verify holdings through the official C8ntinuum Discord to claim the roles and matching p8ints.

steps.title: Qualify Your Account
steps.body: Qualification needs two linked socials (one being the verified X follow), one completed capital or cross-chain action, and no fraud flag. Email does not count as a social. Unqualified accounts still earn, but cannot spend p8ints or appear on the leaderboard.

steps.title: Share Your Referral Link
steps.body: The financial leg is live and pays a 15% referral share. The p8ints leg opens with Phase 2, covers direct referrals only, and pays when someone you referred qualifies and stays active.

items.description: C8ntinuum has announced a live contribution program: p8ints accrue from past and ongoing activity, then become spendable on reward directions that open with the SuperApp. That makes it a points program with an unannounced payoff, alongside other potential retroactive airdrops .

items.name: Amadeus Protocol
items.tagline: Amadeus has not confirmed a token airdrop. What exists today is PRIME Points, an active rewards program tied to AMA Hub

steps.title: Connect a Wallet
steps.body: Open the AMA Hub quests page and connect an EVM wallet such as MetaMask, Rabby, or Trust. This is the address your PRIME Points are paid to.

steps.title: Create Your Amadeus Wallet
steps.body: Install the Amadeus Wallet browser extension and set it up. This wallet holds $AMA and runs your sealed agents, and creating it is one of the larger one-off point rewards in the season.

steps.title: Link Both Wallets
steps.body: Sign once from each wallet to connect them. The link tells the season that your chain address and Amadeus account belong to the same person, and quests stay locked until both are added.

steps.title: Complete the Daily Check-In
steps.body: Return each day and claim the check-in on the quests page. Daily points reset and do not carry over, so steady visits matter more than any single session.

steps.title: Build and Deploy an Agent
steps.body: Create an agent on AMA Hub and put it to work. These build quests are read directly from the chain, so nothing needs to be submitted. To earn across more of them: Add a skill to your agent so it can act Run an agent trade or swap on the network Claim a username for your account

steps.title: Finish the Social Quests
steps.body: Complete the social tasks, which the campaign verifies within a few minutes: Follow Amadeus on X Join the Amadeus Discord Engage with the pinned launch post Record a short video explainer for the largest social reward

steps.title: Invite Referrals
steps.body: Share your referral link from the quests page. You earn 20% of the PRIME Points your invitees collect, which compounds as they stay active.

items.description: Amadeus has not confirmed a token airdrop. What exists today is PRIME Points, an active rewards program tied to AMA Hub Season 01. Points are minted on the Amadeus chain as you complete quests, and secondary coverage has linked them to a possible future $AMA distribution, though the team has not committed to a conversion. Treat any allocation as speculative for now.
